content_sections.heading: NIH Job Description
content_sections.text: Consultant - Water Resources & Technical Coordination [R&D, NWM, New Delhi] To provide technical support for reviewing studies and related activities under NWM, assess technical proposals, and coordinate with NIH, startups, MSMEs, and other stakeholders to develop and implement innovative water-sector solutions. Consultant - Open Call & P programme Management [NIH, Roorkee] To manage and coordinate the overall activities related to the Open Call for Startups and MSMEs, including proposal processing, coordination with applicants, reviewers and stakeholders, evaluation activities, monitoring and reporting. Young Professional - Full Stack Development & Database Management [NIH, Roorkee] To develop, maintain and update the Bharat WIN portal and mobile applications, including front-end, back-end, API, database management, UI/UX and related technical support. Young Professional - Social Media & Digital Content [NIH, Roorkee] To manage social media and digital outreach activities, including creation of graphics, infographics, videos, presentations and other promotional content for the Open Call/Hackathon and other NIH events.
